definitions.explanation: Acting or thinking with careful consideration to avoid risks or mistakes.

notes:
{慎重|しんちょう} implies being careful to avoid mistakes or problems.

FORMS:
- {慎重|しんちょう}な + noun (careful ~)
- {慎重|しんちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb (carefully)
- {慎重|しんちょう}⟦さ→さ：noentry⟧ (carefulness - noun form)

- {慎重|しんちょう}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (careful attitude)

- {慎重|しんちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{期|き}す→期す：noentry⟧ (to be very careful)
